 By 
 Ben Verbrugge 
 |

 Jan 12, 2026; Toronto, Ontario, CAN; Philadelphia 76ers center Joel Embiid (21) drives to the net against Toronto Raptors forward Collin Murray-Boyles (12) during the first half at Scotiabank Arena. Mandatory Credit: John E. Sokolowski-Imagn Images 
 The Toronto Raptors travel to Philadelphia on Thursday night for an Eastern Conference showdown against a star-studded 76ers team featuring LeBron James, Joel Embiid, and Tyrese Maxey.
 Jan 12, 2026; Toronto, Ontario, CAN; Toronto Raptors guard AJ Lawson (0) drives to the net against Philadelphia 76ers forward Jabari Walker (33) during the second half at Scotiabank Arena. Mandatory Credit: John E. Sokolowski-Imagn Images
 How to watch Raptors vs 76ers
 Date: Thursday, November 12, 2026
 Time: 7:00 PM ET
 Channel: NBC Sports Philadelphia
 Stream: Fubo ( try for free ) 
 Toronto enters the matchup looking to snap a losing streak after falling 98-93 to the Boston Celtics on Wednesday. The Raptors have plenty of offensive talent, with RJ Barrett and Immanuel Quickley capable of creating problems for opposing defenses. However, injuries have made life difficult for Toronto, which will need a strong collective effort to compete with Philadelphia on the road.
 The 76ers boast one of the NBA’s most recognizable collections of stars, led by James, Embiid and Maxey, although the availability of James and Embiid remains uncertain. Philadelphia is looking to rebound from Tuesday’s 123-101 loss to Boston after previously defeating Chicago 127-121. With Maxey providing explosive scoring from the backcourt and a talented supporting cast around him, the 76ers have the offensive firepower to challenge anyone in the Eastern Conference.
